contract.task_clause:
Three steel containers hold gas samples. The containers are all the same size and at the same temperature. One container has 4.0 g of helium, another has 28.0 g of nitrogen, and the third has 44.0 g of carbon dioxide. Pick the FALSE statement from the following list:
Option A: The densities increase in the order helium < nitrogen < carbon dioxide.
Option B: The number of molecules in all the containers is the same.
Option C: The pressure in all three containers is the same.
Option D: The average speed of all the molecules is the same.
